name: Perspective gallery (Vanta UI)
summary: Block preview page in Vanta UI, a shadcn-style component registry of 100 items for startups, SaaS and business sites.
description: Preview page for the Perspective gallery block in the Vanta UI component registry. Vanta UI describes itself as a modern component registry for startups, SaaS and businesses that want to build websites quickly; the page sits with visual experiments such as a Nothing Phone (1) launch page, an icon set and a 3D cubes study. The page is JavaScript-rendered, so only part of its text is readable.
